_comment: Maps queryable.json logical field names → physical parquet column names for ClinVar. HAND-MAINTAINED — do not overwrite with gen_schema.py --write. Renames are applied at load time in app/tools/clinvar/app/database_loader.py and are cross-verified by parquet_name: annotations in dbs/clinvar/schema.yaml.
_table:variant_master_table_clinvar: physical parquet cols: review_status, clinical_significance, gene_symbol
_table:variant_disease_association_clinv: physical parquet cols: clinical_significance, disease_name, phenotype_ids
